newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan forex market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan forex market closed for holiday.

text.p: Sri Lanka's foreign exchange market was closed on Tuesday because of a national holiday to mark a Tamil religious festival.
The market will reopen on Wednesday.

The rupee closed firm on Monday, at 57.23 to the dollar after opening at 57.28, despite late demand for dollars, as the local currency gained ground when the buyer of the U.S. unit moved out. The rupee closed at 57.26 on Friday.
